courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 船舶艙室防火分區
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 船體尺度、載荷條件、海況及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Vessel scale, load conditions, sea state and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本專題以艙壁與冷庫隔熱負荷建立起點，接到冷庫空氣混合時間的系統介面，最後用溫濕需求與未建模潛熱整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Begin with Compartment/cold-room conduction, connect through Cold-room mixing time, then integrate evidence using Temperature/humidity needs and latent-load limits. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

history.title: 船舶空調與冷藏負載
history.text: 本專題以艙壁與冷庫隔熱負荷建立起點，接到冷庫空氣混合時間的系統介面，最後用溫濕需求與未建模潛熱整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
history.textEn: Begin with Compartment/cold-room conduction, connect through Cold-room mixing time, then integrate evidence using Temperature/humidity needs and latent-load limits. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

courses.connection: 分開艙室、通風、冷藏與濕度負載，核對冷端移熱和熱端排熱而不混用COP。 在船舶空調冷藏能量室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
courses.connectionEn: Separate compartment, ventilation, refrigeration and moisture loads and reconcile cold-side removal with hot-side rejection. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Marine HVAC/refrigeration energy laboratory. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
